whatflow-shopify-whatsapp-campaign-walkt.heading: Review delivery before
whatflow-shopify-whatsapp-campaign-walkt.copy: For a spreadsheet audience, follow the [field-mapping checklist](/blog/whatflow-whatsapp-campaign-spreadsheet-mapping). If your report already shows failures, use the [failed-broadcast guide](/blog/whatflow-whatsapp-broadcast-failure-retry) to decide whether to pause, correct the input, or retry individual recipients.

whatflow-team-inbox-shopify-support-work.heading: Handoff, resolve
whatflow-team-inbox-shopify-support-work.copy: If your shipping team tracks assignments outside the Inbox, use the [signed webhook guide](/blog/whatflow-team-inbox-signed-webhooks) to test a conversation assignment event against an endpoint you control.

whatflow-shopify-flow-whatsapp-automatio.heading: Can WhatFlow work with my other Shopify apps
whatflow-shopify-flow-whatsapp-automatio.copy: If the event comes from an external system and doesn’t have a Shopify Flow trigger, see [how to build an API-triggered Inbox Workflow](/blog/whatflow-api-triggered-inbox-workflow). It shows how to map a sample event, branch on a field, and test both paths.

product-launch-whatsapp-waitlist.heading: Launch day: be in the inbox
product-launch-whatsapp-waitlist.copy: The [WhatFlow launch reply playbook](/blog/whatflow-whatsapp-product-launch-reply-playbook) shows how to split sizing, stock and order questions between agents and share the right catalog product from the conversation.

whatsapp-campaign-preflight-checklist.heading: The test matrix
whatsapp-campaign-preflight-checklist.copy: If the audience comes from a spreadsheet, test a row with a missing field and verify the final button URL on a phone. Use the [WhatFlow CSV and Excel mapping guide](/blog/whatflow-whatsapp-campaign-spreadsheet-mapping) to check those cases before scheduling.
